title: When Personas Become Harmful: Guiding LLMs with Global Citizenship Values Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.33899v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs are increasingly being used by users from diverse demographics with pluralistic values and distinct backgrounds. Maintaining safety while respecting value-laden personas is uniquely challenging because persona-conditioned requests are often not overtly malicious, unlike those in existing safety benchmarks. Alignment methods aimed at adversarial requests therefore may miss the harm that emerges from persona use, leaving models to either refuse legitimate value expression or blindly follow unsafe personas. We construct a dataset of 11k controversial topics paired with value-based personas mapping to value dimensions from the Schwartz Value Survey. Through an agentic pipeline that iteratively refines the topic and persona, we surface and collect harmful responses from well-aligned commercial LLMs with a more than 47% success rate. translated_title: 当人格设定变得有害：以全球公民价值观对齐引导大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）正日益被来自不同人口群体、拥有多元价值观和不同背景的用户所使用。在尊重带有价值观色彩的人格设定的同时保持安全性是一项独特的挑战，因为基于人格设定的请求通常不像现有安全基准中的请求那样具有明显的恶意。因此，针对对抗性请求设计的对齐方法可能会遗漏由人格设定使用所引发的危害，导致模型要么拒绝合法的价值观表达，要么盲目遵循不安全的人格设定。我们构建了一个包含1.1万个争议性话题的数据集，并将其与基于价值观的人格设定相配对，这些人格设定对应施瓦茨价值观量表（Schwartz Value Survey）中的价值观维度。通过一个迭代优化话题和人格设定的智能体流程，我们以超过47%的成功率从对齐良好的商业大语言模型中诱发出有害响应并加以收集。我们采用联合国教科文组织的全球公民原则作为区分合法价值观表达与有害内容的最小共识基础（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究构建了基于施瓦茨价值观量表的人格设定与争议话题数据集，发现对齐良好的商业大语言模型在响应带价值观人格的请求时仍会以超过47%的成功率产生有害输出，并提出以联合国教科文组织全球公民原则作为最小共识来引导模型在尊重多元价值观的同时保障安全。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a dataset of 11k controversial topics paired with value-based personas from the Schwartz Value Survey, reveals that well-aligned commercial LLMs still produce harmful responses at over a 47% success rate when handling persona-conditioned requests, and proposes using UNESCO's global citizenship principles as a minimal common ground to guide LLMs in balancing safety with pluralistic value expression.
